a1Stacks.label: Lunacy at 3 stacks
a1Stacks.reason: Re-decided as Neuvillette's A1 was: her own Gravity Interference makes the stacks, with no setup by anyone else, and each lasts 10 seconds and is renewed by the next trigger, so in sustained play her Gravity Interference hits at the most stacks after the first few triggers.
